description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing MCQ question creation, course selection, and exam setup within an online examination system.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the SetExam ASP.NET page, handling user interactions for setting up and managing MCQ questions and exams.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load events, currently commented out code related to session management.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on the selected semester, with course options for various academic years and semesters.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields related to question and exam details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database and updates the question number counter.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam for the selected course by inserting exam details into the database, then redirects to AdminPanel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course options based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.
